{"consolidated_memory":"**Truncated documents in search/indexer/chunker.ts — Two separate incidents**

Component: search/indexer/chunker.ts (search side)
Problem: truncated documents in the chunker across two separate incidents
Signal (both cases): chunk offsets that stop short of the document length
Reproducible scenario (both cases): index the long changelog fixture

**Incident 1: [2026-01-16]**
Trigger: Input list came in empty
Root cause: An error swallowed by a bare except clause
Impact: Cold start performance degraded 38 percent, dropped to 441 ms
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
PR: #8397 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1

**Incident 2: [2026-03-17]**
Trigger: After a rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: A listener registered but never removed on teardown
Impact: Throughput improved 2 percent, rose to 80 requests per second
Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
PR: #9546 on branch fix/truncated-documents-2

Context: Both incidents occurred in the same corner of search/indexer/chunker.ts, with context carried over from the earlier truncated documents work."}
